card.name: First word of an organization's name
card.fires_on: The first or second word of a proper organization name, such as a company, hospital, charity or advocacy group, right after a preposition or verb like at, by, help or and.

modes.label: Company or hospital name
modes.description: Opening word of a business or hospital name after at or and.
modes.example: at one of the collecting locations at<< Life>> Technologies.

modes.label: Advocacy or charity group
modes.description: Start of a nonprofit or group name after a verb like help or group.
modes.example: the public advocacy group<< Common>> Cause.

card.writes: Weak output effect; the promoted tokens look unrelated, so no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on the first word of an organization's name, where the rest of the name has yet to come.
